methodology: For each architectural alternative, generate design-around variants that avoid at least one limitation. Each variant has a limitation-avoidance matrix.

alternatives.design_around: Use periodic (not continuous) pressure measurement via a percutaneous needle tap — avoids L2's 'continuously' limitation
alternatives.103_motivation: Periodic measurement is the current standard of care; no motivation to combine with L3-L6
alternatives.blocking_strength: WEAK — does not block the continuous monitoring claim

alternatives.design_around: Use contrast-enhanced imaging (EP3212275A1 method) for prediction — avoids L5's 'without contrast' limitation
alternatives.103_motivation: This IS the prior art (EP3212275A1); no combination needed
alternatives.blocking_strength: WEAK — this is the prior art the invention improves upon

alternatives.design_around: Measure only absolute CSF pressure (not differential) and predict occlusion from absolute pressure trend
alternatives.103_motivation: ICP monitoring is standard; combining with occlusion prediction is known (1,681 patents)
alternatives.blocking_strength: MODERATE — may block if absolute-pressure prediction is deemed equivalent

alternatives.design_around: Use absolute threshold (not rate-of-change) for occlusion prediction — predicts when differential drops below a fixed value rather than when it changes fast
alternatives.103_motivation: Absolute threshold is simpler; a PHOSITA might prefer it
alternatives.blocking_strength: MODERATE — depends on whether rate-of-change is deemed essential

alternatives.design_around: Apply to a ventriculoperitoneal (VP) shunt (not endovascular eShunt) — different anatomy, same pressure-differential principle
alternatives.103_motivation: VP shunts are the standard; combining with pressure monitoring is known
alternatives.blocking_strength: STRONG — may block the endovascular-specific claim but not the broader concept

summary.strongest_for_blocking_competitors: DA-005 (VP shunt alternative) — but this is a different market segment, not a true block
summary.rationale: The claim is reasonably defensible. The strongest design-arounds (DA-003, DA-005) avoid core limitations but target different embodiments (absolute pressure, VP shunt). The endovascular CSF-venous differential with continuous prediction remains defensible.
